# 1974-03-11

Onshore gale most of the day, easing after dark. Washed the glazing at first
light before the wind got up again — see [[lantern-care]] for why that
matters, and [[tide-tables]] for why the relief boat waited until afternoon.

The compressor took longer than usual to come up to pressure and I did not
time it. It should be timed the next cold morning; if it is drifting, the
belt is the first thing to look at.

Left a note to write up the [[storm-glass]] readings against the barometer
one day, because the two disagree in a way that might mean something. Nobody
has written that page, and the link is deliberately left pointing at nothing
so that this fixture demonstrates an unresolved wikilink.
